Usage: zealakit doctor [options]

Check Zealakit runtime and optional Go toolchain availability

Options:
  --json                      Print only machine-readable JSON (stdout contains
                              nothing else)
  --min-go-version <version>  Require Go >= version (e.g. 1.22.0);
                              missing/incompatible then exits non-zero
  --cwd <dir>                 Project directory to check as well (default:
                              current directory)
  -h, --help                  display help for command
